journal_lines: Found a blind in the trees. Not ours. Whoever built it isn't coming back for it.
Poacher's hide. Abandoned in a hurry. Left the gear.
Set up in the same wood as someone else. They left. We stayed. Good find.
Hunting blind in the deep timber. Someone else's work. Our gain.
Blind built into the crook of an oak. Snares set, none triggered. Carried the snares.
Whoever had used the blind had been gone for a season. Knew because of the wasps.
Set up better than expected. Took the rope and the iron, left the wood for the next person.
The blind looked out on a deer path. The deer had not used the path lately. Possibly related.
